tickets.title: Complete household profile update
tickets.text: Refresh the household profile using the latest client-provided information for Arlen Nettlewhisk. Update records to reflect his shift to self‑employment with Pocket Lantern Studio and compare retirement plan options as requested.

subTasks.title: Collect household changes
subTasks.text: Request updates for household members, employment, dependents, contact information, outside advisors, and major life changes since the prior profile review.

subTasks.title: Update planning assumptions
subTasks.text: Record changes to income, savings, spending, insurance coverage, benefits, goals, and risk tolerance in the planning record.

subTasks.title: Advisor review of planning impacts
subTasks.text: Review the updated household profile for retirement income, tax‑aware investment, equity compensation, or estate coordination implications that warrant follow‑up.

tickets.text: Obtain the Teacup Comet Bank signature card, first statement, and online balance export for Pocket Lantern Studio’s business checking account to enable review.

tickets.title: Resolve income forecast discrepancy
tickets.text: Resolve the discrepancy between the projected annual gross revenue of $168,000 and the $132,000 shown in the Marzipan Meadow Bookkeeping worksheet for Arlen Nettlewhisk.
tickets.evidence: A follow-up is needed on the income forecast discrepancy because the call projection showed annual gross revenue of $168,000, while the Marzipan Meadow Bookkeeping worksheet showed $132,000 and excluded one signed retainer;
